evidence_summary: Current official PINA repository and documentation establish pina-org.github.io/PINA as the live documentation host; the matching solver page is available and the obsolete host is preserved as VA000056.
Exact LICENSE at e3615412c149dbf3152433c09cdd741be2b04f62 is MIT. The README Apache-2.0 badge is preserved as a documentation conflict rather than treated as controlling license evidence.

Paper 293 verifies the exact RWTH dataset DOI. The DOI remains unresolved and no matching official current record was identified; current payload and license are finalized unavailable or bounded unknown.
Paper 299 verifies the exact Matrio project as its MIT battery dataset. The exact item is unavailable and no official replacement was identified.
Paper 378 directly uses public CT data at the exact historical GIMIAS URL. The current target is an empty lander and no authoritative replacement was identified.
Paper 406 prints yan.cee.illinois.edu. The corrected site is live; QimingZhu1992/PINN-AM at 25776531a1817a17091cdefac03931a60d8c5ea9 provides paper-specific code and FEM demonstration evidence.
Paper 474 directly identifies the exact Montreal page as the Shapeset-3x2 generator. The page remains unavailable and no authoritative maintained mirror was identified.
Paper 778 supplies the JeongsLee profile, supporting PRL000303. It does not identify PINN-for-ExtremeMechanics; CR000358 therefore remains unlinked.

All deferred CR000174 discoveries were rechecked under the direct PINN/physics-informed-operator/operator-learning inclusion rule, with existing identities reused and unavailable or unrelated discoveries not materialized.
PD000005 DiffBatt is live but no direct PINN, physics-informed neural-operator, operator-learning, or Atlas-paper relationship was established; no CR identity is created.
PD000006 FlowBench returns 404 and no exact moved canonical identity was identified; no CR identity is created.
EquiNO is a live public physics-informed neural-operator repository pinned at be71c1f872c84eaf43ddadba01c8dd54d9c4f544 with MIT license, README, requirements and bundled experiment artifacts.
KPCA-DeepONet is a live public operator-learning repository pinned at ad7d52e41e96bd86dacad770cfd396969be96aa4 with MIT license, README, citation DOI and dependency manifests.
PD000009 FE2-Non-Local-Multi-Scale-Surrogate-Model returns 404 and no exact moved canonical identity was identified; no CR identity is created.
PD000010 Enhancement-of-PIV-via-PINNs is already represented by CR000024 and its existing Atlas 339 relationship; no duplicate resource is created.
PD000011 9eqModel_KNFandLSTM is live but concerns LSTM/Koopman reduced-order turbulence modeling; no direct in-scope or Atlas-paper relationship was established.
Two scientific-review items and seven ordinary manual-review resources each receive an explicit final disposition. No active review checkpoint remains.
